package.description: Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.

en-US.author: Yicheng Wang
en-US.description: Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.
en-US.longDescription: Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
en-US.name: Runner
en-US.releaseNotes:
Runner 0.19.4 is a feature release for macOS, Windows and Linux on top of 0.19.3.
New
- Terminal settings, regrouped and extended. Settings → Terminal is now grouped into Text, Colors, Cursor, Keyboard (macOS only) and Scrollback & selection, and the terminal palettes move there from Appearance. Four new settings: line height, a blinking cursor, the scrollback length, and copy on select. (#930)
- Copy from terminal programs with OSC 52. A yank in Neovim, Helix or tmux (with set-clipboard) now reaches your system clipboard, including over SSH. Programs can only write to the clipboard, never read it, and oversized payloads are ignored. (#899)
- The chat menu moves to the pane title. Click a pane's title to Rename, Fork or Pin the chat; the ⋯ button is gone, and double-clicking the title still renames it. The status and its stop/resume button now sit together on the right of the header. The sidebar row menu lists the same items in the same order. (#1184)
- Maximize a pane. In a split tab, the new maximize button beside split, or ⇧⌘↩ (Ctrl+Shift+Enter on Windows and Linux), lets one pane fill the tab while the others keep running; press it again to restore the layout exactly as it was. (#1184)
- Missions interrupted by a Runner restart say so. When an update or a restart of runnerd kills a member mid-turn, the mission now shows an amber pause and Interrupted instead of settling, the feed names the member whose turn was lost, and the linked chat gets one "interrupted by a Runner restart" report instead of "settled". Message the member to continue. (#1187)
- The computer picker moves to the sidebar footer. Signed in to Remote access, a host button between usage and Settings opens the list of computers, with this computer first and highlighted. The button stays in the footer, and turns green, while a window shows another computer. (#1118)
Bug fixes
- Bare Ctrl keys reach the terminal on Windows and Linux. Ctrl+D, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+S and Ctrl+M no longer split a pane, open the command palette, toggle the sidebar or minimize the window while a terminal has focus. The new defaults are Ctrl+Shift+D to split right, Alt+Shift+D to split down, Ctrl+Shift+P for the command palette and Ctrl+B for the sidebar; your own saved shortcuts are kept. A new Ctrl keys in terminals setting, under Settings → Keyboard shortcuts, can give terminals every bare Ctrl key. (#1177)
- Ctrl+C interrupts again after copying. On Windows and Linux, a Ctrl+C that copies a selection now clears it, so the next Ctrl+C reaches the terminal as an interrupt, as in Windows Terminal. (#1178)
- A terminal tab's status follows the shell. Working and Idle now come from the shell's prompt, so the dot turns Idle as soon as a command finishes instead of about two seconds later, and typing at the prompt no longer shows Working. (#1172)
- Codex chats stop retrying a conversation that no longer exists. Resume now checks whether the Codex conversation is still on disk, including compressed rollouts, and recovers the chat's original conversation when an earlier bug replaced its key, instead of failing with "No saved session found" on every Resume. (#1139)
- Mission members post their results to the feed. Every member, including one added with runner mission add-role, is now told to post what it did with runner msg post when it finishes a task, so the result no longer stays only in its own terminal. (#1151)
- Runner no longer starts Antigravity's login flow. The background usage check ran agy even when it was signed out, which made it begin logging in; Runner no longer checks Antigravity usage. (#1163)
- An app reliably pauses beside another build's runnerd. Two races could make an app take over another Runner build's running daemon instead of pausing with the in-use notice. (#1160)
- The sidebar's resize handle is centred on the main pane's border, and that border stays under the pointer while you drag. (#1193)
Nightly channel
- A separate Preview Nightly channel. Builds of large features still in development, starting with file preview (#634), now go to their own Preview Nightly channel, shown as Preview Nightly (sha) in Settings → Updates. The Nightly channel from main and stable releases are unchanged; installing a Nightly or stable build by hand moves an install back. (#1166)

zh-CN.description: 让 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot CLI 等终端编码智能体在同一个 mission 上协同工作。
zh-CN.longDescription: Runner 是一款原生桌面应用，让终端智能体协同工作。Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor CLI、Grok Build、Antigravity CLI、Copilot CLI 与 pi 可以在同一个任务、同一个 mission 中配合，每个智能体都保留自己真实终端里的 TUI，由 lead 把决策带回给你。Runner 的一切能力都对应一个 `runner` 命令：mission、crew、role、project、chat、session 与 msg 都能在命令行操作，后台服务是 `runnerd`。智能体在 Windows 上原生运行，不需要 WSL，PowerShell 7 为可选。当前状态：alpha，持续发布。原生支持 macOS（Apple Silicon）与 Windows（x64，Windows 10 1809 或更高版本）；不支持 Intel Mac、Windows ARM64 与 Linux。安装程序、应用与 CLI 辅助程序均使用签发给 Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang 的 Certum 开源代码签名证书签名。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Runner 0.19.4 是 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上基于 0.19.3 的功能版本。
新功能
- 终端设置重新分组并新增选项。 Settings → Terminal 现在分为 Text、Colors、Cursor、Keyboard（仅 macOS）和 Scrollback & selection 几组，终端配色方案也从 Appearance 移到这里。新增四项设置：行高、光标闪烁、回滚行数和选中即复制。(#930)
- 终端程序可通过 OSC 52 复制。 在 Neovim、Helix 或 tmux（开启 set-clipboard）中复制的内容现在会进入系统剪贴板，通过 SSH 时也可以。程序只能写入剪贴板，不能读取，超大的内容会被忽略。(#899)
- 聊天菜单移到窗格标题上。 点击窗格标题即可 Rename、Fork 或 Pin 该聊天；⋯ 按钮已移除，双击标题仍可直接重命名。状态和停止/恢复按钮现在一起位于标题栏右侧。侧栏条目菜单的项目和顺序与之一致。(#1184)
- 最大化窗格。 在分屏 tab 中，点击分屏按钮旁新增的最大化按钮，或按 ⇧⌘↩（Windows 和 Linux 上为 Ctrl+Shift+Enter），可让一个窗格占满整个 tab，其他窗格继续运行；再按一次即按原样恢复布局。(#1184)
- 因 Runner 重启而中断的 mission 会明确显示。 当更新或 runnerd 重启在成员执行中途将其终止时，mission 现在会显示琥珀色暂停图标和 Interrupted，而不是进入稳定状态；动态中会指出哪个成员的那一轮被中断，关联的聊天会收到一条“被 Runner 重启中断”的提示，而不是 "settled"。给该成员发消息即可继续。(#1187)
- 电脑选择器移到侧栏底部。 登录 Remote access 后，用量和 Settings 之间的主机按钮会打开电脑列表，本机排在首位并突出显示。窗口显示其他电脑时，该按钮仍在底部并变为绿色。(#1118)
问题修复
- 在 Windows 和 Linux 上，单独的 Ctrl 组合键会交给终端。 终端获得焦点时，Ctrl+D、Ctrl+K、Ctrl+S 和 Ctrl+M 不再拆分窗格、打开命令面板、切换侧栏或最小化窗口。新的默认快捷键为：Ctrl+Shift+D 向右拆分、Alt+Shift+D 向下拆分、Ctrl+Shift+P 打开命令面板、Ctrl+B 切换侧栏；你自己保存的快捷键保持不变。Settings → Keyboard shortcuts 中新增的 Ctrl keys in terminals 设置可以把所有单独的 Ctrl 组合键都交给终端。(#1177)
- 复制后 Ctrl+C 可以再次中断。 在 Windows 和 Linux 上，用 Ctrl+C 复制选中内容后会清除选区，下一次 Ctrl+C 会作为中断信号发给终端，与 Windows Terminal 一致。(#1178)
- 终端 tab 的状态跟随 shell。 Working 和 Idle 现在根据 shell 提示符判断，命令结束后状态点立即变为 Idle，而不是约两秒后，在提示符处输入也不再显示 Working。(#1172)
- Codex 聊天不再反复重试已不存在的会话。 Resume 现在会检查 Codex 会话是否仍在磁盘上（包括压缩的 rollout），并在之前的 bug 替换了会话 key 时恢复聊天原来的会话，而不是每次 Resume 都报 "No saved session found"。(#1139)
- mission 成员会把结果发到动态中。 每个成员（包括用 runner mission add-role 加入的成员）现在都会被告知，完成任务时用 runner msg post 发布所做的工作，结果不再只留在它自己的终端里。(#1151)
- Runner 不再触发 Antigravity 的登录流程。 后台用量检查会在 agy 未登录时运行它，导致它开始登录；Runner 现在不再检查 Antigravity 的用量。(#1163)
- 遇到另一构建的 runnerd 时，应用会可靠地暂停。 两个竞态问题可能导致应用接管另一个 Runner 构建正在运行的 daemon，而不是暂停并显示占用提示。(#1160)
- 侧栏的拖动调整手柄现在位于主窗格边框的正中， 拖动时该边框始终跟随指针。(#1193)
Nightly 渠道
- 独立的 Preview Nightly 渠道。 仍在开发中的大型功能（首先是文件预览，#634）的构建现在发布到独立的 Preview Nightly 渠道，在 Settings → Updates 中显示为 Preview Nightly (sha)。来自 main 的 Nightly 渠道和正式版不受影响；手动安装 Nightly 或正式版构建即可切回。(#1166)
